reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding — the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs.

The cited paragraphs support compliance: p0047 is a mutual employee non-solicitation (personnel hiring, not a restriction on the businesses we operate or products we buy/build), and p0020 is an ordinary licence-scope limit on the Contractor's own pre-existing proprietary materials, not a field-of-use or competitive restriction on Customer.

No 'shall not develop/market/sell/compete', competing-product, exclusivity or territory covenant binding Company is present, so the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer) is met; the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction remains.
Rationale accurately notes the two adjacent covenants and explains why neither triggers the rule, avoiding over-flagging under a restrictive-covenants theory.
